query:
SELECT 
  cq.searchId,
  cq.status,
  COUNT(*) as count,
  MIN(cq.createdAt) as oldest_job,
  MAX(cq.createdAt) as newest_job,
  cq.companyName as currently_running
FROM campaign_queue cq
WHERE cq.status IN ('pending', 'running')
GROUP BY cq.searchId, cq.status
ORDER BY cq.searchId, cq.status;
